Business Unit
The S3 HR and Management Line follows a "User-Focused and Employee-Oriented" philosophy and employs a three-pillar HR organization model. By offering "productized services and marketized management," the S3 HR and Management Line provides comprehensive support for developing Tencent's organization, talent, and culture, enabling employees to grow with the company.

What the Role Entails
Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to understand hiring needs and qualifications required to source for open positions.
Conduct market research and talent mapping to identify potential candidate pools and sourcing channels.
Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand roles across different markets and platforms.
Engage with prospective candidates via emails, social media, and phone calls to introduce job opportunities and assess initial interest.
Support referral initiatives and creative outreach campaigns (e.g. campus recruitment) to expand talent reach.
Leverage on internal tracker to measure and report on how well sourcing strategies are performing (e.g. conversion rates), and turn these findings into recommendations that tighten up the sourcing funnel.

Who We Look For
Currently an undergraduate or master’s degree student in across any disciplines with a strong interest and passion in recruitment is preferred.
Ideally with prior recruitment and/or sourcing experience with exposure to Boolean searches·
Strong analytical skills, proficiency in gathering and analysing information, and ability to identify problems through the information.
Ability to adapt to cross-regional and cross-cultural work patterns. Great teamwork spirit, strong communication skills, and fast-learning ability.
Fluency in Chinese and English is valued in order to communicate with various stakeholders in headquarters over the globe.

Canada-British Columbia-Vancouver
